And he asked if there was any wish he could grant, as the least he could do to atone.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Your father's wish then was... that your mother and you would live on safely from then on.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:9504}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Dad's wish...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Taking those words to heart, he resolved to stay by your side.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}And so he came to you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:9604}{spk:0080}{n}......
